data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 破晓跑道的弯道全速冲刺
data.description: 石蕗高中田径场红色塑胶跑道上，清晨第一道朝阳穿透薄雾。柠檬在弯道全力加速冲刺，健美小麦色肌肤与马甲线在晨曦中生辉，飞扬的泥土与汗珠折射金色朝芒。
data.location: sunlit red running track curve around high school sports stadium with morning dew
data.action: sprinting dynamically through track curve with powerful athletic stride, toned tanned limbs pumping, determined focused joyful smile
data.lighting: 初升朝阳金光逆射与薄雾丁达尔光
data.promptProse: Lemon sprints powerfully around the curved running track in the golden morning mist, her toned tanned skin glistening with sweat in the sunrise.
data.animaCaption: Early morning rays pierce the stadium mist as her athletic stride kicks up track dust.
